Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. ---
Hi null, it’s Haley Stevens. When President Obama created the Auto Rescue Task Force during the 2008 financial crisis, I got the call to serve. I was working long nights as chief of staff – and yes, sometimes even returning calls from President Obama himself.
That was a critical moment for Michigan. We were on the brink of losing the heart of our economy and were fighting to save the American auto industry and protect hundreds of thousands of Michigan jobs.
**[If you believe in that kind of leadership – grounded in fighting for working people – will you chip in $5 to help us hit tonight’s $350,000 end-of-month goal and win this battleground Senate race in Michigan?](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/13320?t=3&akid=2106%2E49239%2EFdzH4V)**
| | [Donate Now](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/13321?t=4&akid=2106%2E49239%2EFdzH4V)
---
I can tell you firsthand, during the auto rescue, people didn’t ask for handouts. They asked for a shot to get back on their feet, back on the job, and back to building a future for their families.
I visited engineering plants and auto suppliers, union halls, and job training programs. I listened to people’s fears, frustrations, and hopes – and I fought to make sure the federal government didn’t let them down.
We helped save 200,000 Michigan jobs. Not with noise or headlines. Not with awards or parades. But with real work, real problem-solving, and a commitment to the people who power this state.
That’s what I’ve done in Congress. And that’s exactly the kind of senator I’ll be.
**[If you believe Michigan deserves a fighter in the Senate, will you chip in $5 right now to help us hit our goal, keep this seat blue, and flip the Senate?](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/13320?t=5&akid=2106%2E49239%2EFdzH4V)**

With love and grit,

Haley

subject: I’m with Deb Haaland for Governor of New Mexico
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
Will you join me in endorsing Deb to become the next Governor of New Mexico?

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=7206%2E400544%2E7Vhxmk)
---
Hi there, it’s Jane Fonda!

You may know me as an actor — and as someone who’s never been very good at staying quiet about the things I care deeply about. When something matters, I speak up. That’s just how I’ve always been.

**And right now, I care deeply about the future of New Mexico, which is why I'm endorsing my friend Deb Haaland to be the next governor.**
Deb is a fierce fighter who will protect New Mexico’s lands, waters, and air from Donald Trump and corporate polluters, and **she will always put people over profits.** That’s why, with my whole heart, I’m proud to endorse her as the next governor of New Mexico. **[I’m asking you to stand with me, friend: Add your name today to show your support for Deb Haaland and help build the people-powered movement it will take to win.](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/email_mw_202601_endorse_fonda/?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&source=jtk243-su-nd&refcode=jtk243-su-nd&t=2&akid=7206%2E400544%2E7Vhxmk)**

---
With extreme heat, scarce and contaminated water, and a drying-up Rio Grande basin threatening New Mexicans (and all of us), it's strikingly clear that we need leaders who will stand up to the GOP's anti-environmental agenda. And I can't think of a better person for the job than Deb.
Deb and I have been in the climate fight together for some time, and I can say with my whole heart she’s exactly the kind of leader I had in mind when I launched the Jane Fonda Climate PAC and exactly the kind of leader New Mexico needs right now.
**I will do whatever I can to help send Deb Haaland to the governor's office in New Mexico, but she needs each and every one of us with her.[Will you join me in endorsing Deb Haaland's campaign to be the next governor of New Mexico?](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/email_mw_202601_endorse_fonda/?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&source=jtk243-su-nd&refcode=jtk243-su-nd&t=4&akid=7206%2E400544%2E7Vhxmk)**

📣 January Capitol Update 🏛️ A Busy Start to the Legislative Session The past month has been super busy with productive meetings at the capitol. 🎉 Opening Day – January 12 👥 I invited five guests to the State Senate for this annual ritual, including
* Jamie Balson, Executive Director for [Legal Services for Crime Victims in Arizona](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3877fbbc6c&e=a7ab36849c)
* Beth Goulden, Chairwoman of the [Arizona Sex Offender Management Board](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3bdad3df8d&e=a7ab36849c)
* Gina Godbehere, CEO of [Speak Up Stand Up Save a Life](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=0dfaea28cd&e=a7ab36849c)
* Sean McMahon, is a grassroots engagement director for an Arizona-based [nonprofit](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=acf5f27084&e=a7ab36849c)
* Ella Sullivan Ramsay, lives in Arizona with her family, while working for a national [institute](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=2dcd077425&e=a7ab36849c) focused on religious freedom and pro parental rights aligning with Judeo Christian values
* Terry Stines, a vocal proponent of our career and technical education in our high schools as an amazing board member on [West-MEC](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=535237bfe9&e=a7ab36849c), and
* Carol Stines is a retired teacher at a private Christian school and very involved in our local north Phoenix community.

📘 Legislative Work & Committees 💼 Bringing Certainty to Taxpayers Back at the Capitol on January 14th, I participated as a member on the Senate Committee on Finance to address tax conformity in a joint meeting with the House Committee on Ways and Means. Nearly each session the legislature passes an annual tax conformity bill to conform with changes made by the U.S. Congress. This year’s annual conformity will address [H.R.1](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=cc46e5411b&e=a7ab36849c), also known as the “One Big Beautiful Bill Act” signed by Trump last summer. The republican majority wants to roll out the tax cut provisions over the next three years to the tune of more than $1 billion dollars. The republican-sponsored legislation, HB 2153, and SB 1106 would have helped deliver certainty by passing provisions linked to the One Big Beautiful Bill. Sadly, shortly after the legislature passed this bill the governor vetoed it. The Republicans are eager to get a tax conformity bill passed so individuals and small businesses have clear certainty and won’t have to file amended tax returns with the Arizona Department of Revenue (AZDOR). [We will try again](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3418d669d5&e=a7ab36849c) next Thursday morning with a special Senate Committee on Finance. [Senate Bill 1638](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=d3d669ff88&e=a7ab36849c) is aligned with the tax forms issued by AZDOR. For some reason, this government agency did its own thing creating confusion even though the current governor disagreed with their actions and they weren’t reined in. 🗂️ Committee Leadership & Reviews The second day of session as the committee chair, I convened a special meeting for the Senate Committee on Regulatory Affairs and Government Efficiency Committee of Reference to address the sunset review of the Department of Gaming, Arizona Racing Commission, Arizona Barbering and Cosmetology Board, Arizona Boxing and Mixed Martial Arts Commission, and the performance audit review of the Arizona Tourism and Sports Authority. 🤝 Community Involvement On January 14th, I returned to [Arrowhead Republican Women’s Club](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=cc574ccbff&e=a7ab36849c) to give an update on the State Senate Republican Majority’s plan for 2026. As you may know, the Arizona Senate Republicans are working hard to preserving your freedoms, keeping government limited and increasing opportunities for all Arizonans. On January 24th I attended our annual National School Choice Week kick-off event. I had a chance to talk with dozens of administrators and teachers from public and private schools about Arizona’s school choice options.
⚠️ Capitol Activity On January 15th, I read a proclamation calling on all levels of government to ensure law enforcement professionals receive the support and resources needed to keep us safe. I had worked with a national nonprofit, [Citizens Behind the Badge](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=ac4b7f48ae&e=a7ab36849c) on this effort. As a voice for anti-human trafficking efforts in our state, on January 22nd, I filmed an anti-human trafficking ad for an upcoming Night of Hope event on February 22nd. Later that day, I read a proclamation on the floor of the Senate joining with other partners in our state and communities to fight against human trafficking. On January 27h, I helped kick-off the Senate celebrating National School Choice Week by reading a proclamation on the floor. Since we reconvened this current legislative session, there have been protests nearly every day at the capitol. This past Thursday the governor asked the Attorney General to retract ICE comments stating, “I think her comments were inappropriate, and she should retract them.” 🔍 Key Issues & Looking Ahead 💰 Budget & Federal Funding In addition to tax conformity, Arizona will have to make up for lost federal dollars for Medicaid spending and SNAP benefits (i.e., food stamps) over the next few years. Several bills we passed last year were vetoed by the governor. We are still actively working to get rid of the waste, fraud and abuse that exists in the current system. 💧 Water Policy After we vote out this next tax conformity bill, we will likely shift to water. As you all may know, the Colorado supplies us with one third of our water. Right before Christmas, the Colorado River basin states met in Vegas to discuss an agreement on managing the Colorado River. Sadly, the seven basin states failed to reach a deal. 📚 Prop 123 Renewal For the past two legislative sessions, the House and Senate haven’t been able to agree on how to renew Prop. 123, which is a major funding source to fund our public-schools. In 2016, the voters approved more money being drawn down for the sales of our state lands to fund K-12 public education. 📌 Majority Priorities for 2026
The State Senate Republicans will be working hard between now and April to get our majority plan passed. Our focus remains on
* reducing Arizonans’ cost of living, and
* addressing the housing shortage impacting young adults and working class the most

We will continue protecting school choice, strengthening public safety, and stopping California-style policies that threaten affordability and opportunity for all Arizonans. It’s an honor to stay in touch with so many dedicated community members. Thank you for taking the time to read this update 📜 Bolick Bills Advanced Out of Committee 💵 Voted out of Appropriations [Senate Bill 1032](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=2854a9556a&e=a7ab36849c) [Senate Bill 1209](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=2db5e9991f&e=a7ab36849c) 🗳️ Federalism [Senate Bill 1141](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=ae5764d734&e=a7ab36849c) ⚖️ Judiciary & Elections [Senate Bill 1168](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=8bfa828ff0&e=a7ab36849c) [SCR 1001](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=57763198e3&e=a7ab36849c) [Senate Bill 1211](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=1288378445&e=a7ab36849c) 💼 Finance [Senate Bill 1142](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=0bb174266e&e=a7ab36849c) 🏫 Education [Senate Bill 1143](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=878d71658a&e=a7ab36849c) 📑 Regulatory Affairs & Government Efficiency [Senate Bill 1145](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=a37c797249&e=a7ab36849c) 📰 Bolick in the News [https://www.fox10phoenix.com/news/push-1-5m-prison-oversight-funding-follows-deadly-december&ct=ga&cd=CAEYACoSNzU0MDgzOTMwODM4NDczOTMyMho2Y2RjZDFhMzE1YTAyNGUyOmNvbTplbjpVUw&usg=AOvVaw0hXTAAKy_QXjhdhQCaxmh4](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=342db7136e&e=a7ab36849c) [https://www.law360.com/tax-authority/articles/2429551](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=8f80a545f6&e=a7ab36849c)? We are still actively working to get rid of the waste, fraud and abuse that exists in the current system. 💧 Water Policy After we vote out this next tax conformity bill, we will likely shift to water. As you all may know, the Colorado supplies us with one third of our water. Right before Christmas, the Colorado River basin states met in Vegas to discuss an agreement on managing the Colorado River. Sadly, the seven basin states failed to reach a deal. 📚 Prop 123 Renewal For the past two legislative sessions, the House and Senate haven’t been able to agree on how to renew Prop. 123, which is a major funding source to fund our public-schools. In 2016, the voters approved more money being drawn down for the sales of our state lands to fund K-12 public education. 📌 Majority Priorities for 2026 The State Senate Republicans will be working hard between now and April to get our majority plan passed. Our focus remains on reducing Arizonans’ cost of living, and addressing the housing shortage impacting young adults and working class the most We will continue protecting school choice, strengthening public safety, and stopping California-style policies that threaten affordability and opportunity for all Arizonans. It’s an honor to stay in touch with so many dedicated community members. Thank you for taking the time to read this update 📜 Bolick Bills Advanced Out of Committee 💵 Voted out of Appropriations 🗳️ Federalism ⚖️ Judiciary & Elections 💼 Finance 🏫 Education 📑 Regulatory Affairs & Government Efficiency 📰 Bolick in the News ? | | 📌 Campaign Update**👉 Please** to sign my online nomination petition to help me qualify for the August Republican primary ballot. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | 👉 Please to donate to my campaign to keep our momentum going. | | | | | | | We are back in session and I need your help more than ever! This has to be one of Trump’s most vile and disturbing efforts yet:
His administration is attempting to dismantle long-standing protections for immigrant children to prolong their detention .
It’s shameful — so this week, I led a coalition of 20 attorneys general in opposing Trump’s attempts to terminate the Flores Settlement Agreement.
This settlement has been in place for nearly 30 years. It establishes protections to ensure that children in immigration custody are treated with care, held in state-licensed facilities, released without unnecessary delay, and protected by basic standards for health, safety, education, and well-being.
By terminating the Flores Agreement, the administration can expand family detention and keep children confined for longer periods of time — often in facilities that are not licensed, not properly overseen, and not designed to meet children’s needs. To remove these protections could cause significant long-term harm to these kids’ physical, mental, and emotional health.
Let’s be clear: NO child deserves to be left in potentially unsafe or unhealthy conditions, or subjected to prolonged confinement. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/VnVjO0Q2WEiFnysrDRfTxg2]
That’s why we filed a multistate amicus brief urging the Ninth Circuit to block this cruel attempt and keep these critical protections in place.
Unfortunately, we’ve been here before. When the first Trump administration tried to end the Flores protections, California fought back — and the courts agreed. But now, Trump is once again trying to strip them away.
Shame on this administration for using vulnerable immigrant children as political pawns to further their extreme ideological agenda.
I am committed to continuing the fight for the protection, welfare, and safety of all children, regardless of their immigration status, and I need to know you’re with me.
Add your name to our petition to say loud and clear: No child should experience prolonged or unsafe conditions while in immigration detention. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/VnVjO0Q2WEiFnysrDRfTxg2]
Thank you for being a part of this work. It’s never been more important.
In solidarity,
Rob

Attorney General of California

body:
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9qsju&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9qsju&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9qsju&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9qsju&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9qsju&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9qsju&__onlt=h)
---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9qsju&__onlt=h)

Never mind that Georgia conducted two full recounts of the 2020 election — one by machine and another by hand. Never mind the millions of taxpayers dollars spent by Georgia investigating the lies and conspiracy theories about fraud that found nothing. Forget the fact that Trump and his allies filed, and lost, eight cases aimed at throwing out the results.
This ballot seizure is a strategic effort to cast doubt on the veracity of the 2020 election and a dry run to do the same if MAGA-aligned candidates lose in 2026.
RUSH $35 or more right now to fuel our efforts to protect our fundamental right to vote and make every vote count in November nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=013126_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
AJC: FBI raids Fulton County, Georgia, election office [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=013126_2&amount=25]
Two days ago, Team, the FBI raided the Fulton County, Georgia, (home to Atlanta) Elections Operation Center. The Atlanta Journal-Constitution (AJC) reported that the activity was “ apparently connected to the Trump administration’s long-held and disproven belief that Fulton’s handling of the 2020 presidential election was rife with fraud .”
You read that right -- instead of focusing on the crucial issues facing our country, MAGA and Trump have weaponized the investigative power of the Justice Department and the FBI to try and justify their lies that the 2020 election was stolen from him .
The search warrant authorized agents to search for and seize all “physical ballots from the 2020 general election” as well as ballot images produced by scanning ballots, voter rolls from that year, and tabulator tapes. It’s highly unlikely the investigation will turn up any vote count fraud connected to the 2020 election results in Fulton County as those results, like elsewhere, have been recounted, audited, and litigated already, costing millions in taxpayer dollars and finding no misdeeds.
That's not stopping the opponents of voting rights in the Trump administration, however. This is their perfect opportunity for a test run of their suppressive power ahead of November's midterm elections.
We must do everything we can to protect our free and fair elections -- not just before them, but during and after. Help our fight to make every vote count with $35 or whatever you can today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=013126_2&amount=35]

* * *
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9qt5l&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9qt5l&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9qt5l&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9qt5l&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9qt5l&__onlt=h)**
---

**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.greatamericandigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t9qt5l&__onlt=h)
---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

name: Beto O'Rourke (via LeftNet)
subject: This is how Texans take our power back
body:
Texas is worth fighting for – every year, and not just during elections.
#
I won’t be endorsing in the upcoming Texas primary.
Texas doesn’t change because of one election or one politician. It changes when people organize — year-round, everywhere — so voters decide our future. And right now, that’s the most important thing we can do.
We trust the primary voters to pick the best candidates to ensure that we have the strongest nominees to win critical races up and down the ballot. Our job is to do the work so that those candidates can count on enough new voters on the rolls to have a real shot at coming out on top.
We’re focused on bringing amazing people into the effort, to reach, register and turn out the margin of victory in November. Will you be one of those people? **[Add your name to stand with Powered by People and grow the grassroots movement Texas needs to win.](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22302?t=1&akid=1492%2E2118727%2EWTVXjj)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22302?t=2&akid=1492%2E2118727%2EWTVXjj)**
By signing this petition, you’re saying:
* Texas is worth fighting for — every year, not just during elections
* Democracy works best when voters lead
* Organizing should be people-powered

We’ll stay independent and focused on organizing voters, not picking favorites. The most important choice isn’t who gets an endorsement. It’s whether more Texans step into this movement to win political power.
[**Add your name today and be part of the people-powered work Texas needs.**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22302?t=3&akid=1492%2E2118727%2EWTVXjj)
With gratitude,
Beto O’Rourke

subject: Let me explain
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Steve Daines for Montana
body:
Democrats are outspending Republicans by historic margins across the country, in races that wouldn’t have been considered battleground races just a few years ago. |
---
Fellow American,

I know this is the time you start receiving a lot of emails about the first End-of-Month fundraising deadline of 2026. Most of the emails will tell you it's an important deadline, but they will rarely explain why these End-of-Month deadlines are so critical to a campaign's success.

**That's why I wanted to take a minute to break down why tonight's deadline is so important and not just a marketing gimmick.** After you hear my explanation, I hope you'll join our fight by pitching in a few dollars ahead of tonight.

Democrats are outspending Republicans by historic margins across the country, in races that wouldn't have been considered battleground races just a few years ago. They're relying on a radical base of megadonors and extremist special interest groups to fuel their campaigns.

We don't have their base of extremist megadonors. We're a grassroots-powered campaign. That means, to compete, every ad and voter outreach campaign needs to be carefully planned, budgeted for, and executed. That's where our End-of-Month fundraising deadlines come into play - _especially the first of the Election Year._

Months in advance, my campaign team sets specific monthly fundraising benchmarks to run the ads and target the voters we need to secure victory. These fundraising targets allow my team to plan our winning voter outreach strategy and combat anything the Democrats throw at us.

In a race this expensive and contentious, **[every End-of-Month fundraising deadline counts.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=c7050962e9b749e3918d53513dbe167f&_e=uEr-iTvp2PeCehnbRwphHJdChczOToJmChs4GV3KZfvALqx6POacdeD-dOWSXLjH26vPRMsP1DmlDfdjrpdhKYGipil3HuWhH5UO4vas_zM_2IOTslj3CcE0yj2IY4qlwd7xbY0lUX4wBpkdkLyptG_QEBVzTB0KiNmuXSrOI2tDGkIhn6s8dUnBvXzr1WncsSCWUsiJOYkrCH625oXdzkFhQTqijk7xGIOELgkrip_OkaM2GKI5L7KF5L97YYNzKVrQnQWnUQlnR1pveF58F4B8DjFSsRHXisO4hejcxAaUoZB1VsC1-1Ue_SLUDkWaF5da2gWB-XABNcWytIYrN-t5hzHLUtNM-iqBsdcDKhQLwKrwcDyXDmQFea9Rmlg9976NYufDDmCypVPW0k-DRhN_Yd3ZNBbMRvJVzqj8rJ3WUdQq11SbK9rr4aQpsWJNdJYwUIpFBJVzFgQl7BytJ4qgjwCDGIQL9dB9Y0fV9t-qsFH_82NGsSMoof4hFKo8Sv2wiQrdEDV_EKvNrsxKoW4LzN-OqP_nTOhPRannc5-rldjEPqJ2kwYpmxNLyhda5MEUrMJ94njxZHWeVQ_H4y377YymaK_sw1aIsg7loz-QjyqhJMUbvxiHbKZAm3y1apneoJTfc9MgYTxyp3PRZhm3Ss5aOBbpa3cNX1zwz_26ytkjLN-KYtTiUlVyVkAfaqfZ7_fXggsyBgLtT0nkV4F45jkgz6Ys0PkCxV5p1Uo9gU9CJyzf6yIDQAk0QsZA)** One down month or a missed deadline could permanently put us on the defensive, jeopardizing our Republican majority.

With less than 24 hours left before January ends, my team is only $2,030 short of our benchmark. clean_body: Democrats are outspending Republicans by historic margins across the country, in races that wouldn’t have been considered battleground races just a few years ago. | Fellow American, I know this is the time you start receiving a lot of emails about the first End-of-Month fundraising deadline of 2026. Most of the emails will tell you it's an important deadline, but they will rarely explain why these End-of-Month deadlines are so critical to a campaign's success. That's why I wanted to take a minute to break down why tonight's deadline is so important and not just a marketing gimmick. After you hear my explanation, I hope you'll join our fight by pitching in a few dollars ahead of tonight. Democrats are outspending Republicans by historic margins across the country, in races that wouldn't have been considered battleground races just a few years ago. They're relying on a radical base of megadonors and extremist special interest groups to fuel their campaigns. We don't have their base of extremist megadonors. We're a grassroots-powered campaign. That means, to compete, every ad and voter outreach campaign needs to be carefully planned, budgeted for, and executed. That's where our End-of-Month fundraising deadlines come into play - especially the first of the Election Year. Months in advance, my campaign team sets specific monthly fundraising benchmarks to run the ads and target the voters we need to secure victory. These fundraising targets allow my team to plan our winning voter outreach strategy and combat anything the Democrats throw at us. In a race this expensive and contentious, One down month or a missed deadline could permanently put us on the defensive, jeopardizing our Republican majority. With less than 24 hours left before January ends, my team is only $2,030 short of our benchmark. I know it doesn't sound like a lot, but with the amount Democrats are spending against us, EVERY dollar matters. Even coming up a few dollars short means critical campaign operations will have to be scaled back. will give my team the resources they need to execute a winning campaign strategy to keep this seat in Republican hands. Thanks for standing with me, Steve Daines P.S. To give an idea of what we're up against. Democrats spent over $90 million in Montana in the 2024 election. The biggest reason we came out on top was because of the support of grassroots conservatives like you. Steve Daines is a fifth-generation Montanan, life-long sportsman and father of four serving the people of Montana as their Senator. Steve is committed to always putting Montana first as he works to bring real change to Washington and fights for more jobs, less government and common sense solutions to get our country back on track. | |
January has felt like a decade, hasn’t it?
As the month comes to a close, I wanted to take the time to tell you what I’ve been up to on our campaign.
I’ve been hard at work, earning the endorsements of trusted and mighty organizations here in our district and across our great state. I’m so proud to announce that I’ve earned the endorsements of the San Antonio Tejano Democrats, San Antonio Stonewall Democrats, Bexar County Young Democrats, San Antonio Central Labor Council, Austin Central Labor Council, and the Texas AFL-CIO. As a Latina, ally, and working-class Democrat, I couldn’t be more proud!

| | I’ve also been hard at work campaigning throughout the district to share the message that a better future for Texas and our nation is possible if we change the hands of power.
I’ve met thousands of voters across seven counties at six organizational meetings, five candidate forums, five protests, four meet and greets, four community-wide events, four political rallies, and two fundraisers.
---
[|
---](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=6046495992&e=395a33a3d2)

---
[|
---](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=ecb19bfac3&e=395a33a3d2)
| | I know so many folks are fearful, angry, and saddened right now by what’s happening in our country. I know because I’ve been knocking doors and making calls. Just last night, I called and spoke to a woman who immediately started crying on the phone. She doesn’t know what to do. I could hear the fear in her voice, and I want everyone to know that WE ARE IN THIS TOGETHER AND OUR UNITY IS OUR STRENGTH!
If you’re looking to turn your grief and anger into action, then [sign up to volunteer with our team this weekend](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=e3fce7ed12&e=395a33a3d2) to let our neighbors know that change is possible.

Today we are $4,501 short of our end-of-month fundraising goal. To everyone who has donated already, THANK YOU SO MUCH! Your support means everything to me and has helped me build an incredible team to launch and fly this plane!

* * *

Peter,

It may seem obvious to folks like you, but not everyone knows what's on the line next year. Most may not even know taxes are changing.

The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) included seven major tax cuts that took effect for 2025:
1. Maximum child tax credit increase of $200
2. Standard deduction increase of $750 for single filers and $1,500 for joint filers
3. State and local tax (SALT) deduction cap increase to $40,000 for taxpayers earning under $500,000
4. New $6,000 additional deduction for seniors that starts phasing out when taxpayers make more than $75,000 ($150,000 joint)
5. New $10,000 auto loan interest deduction that starts phasing out when taxpayers make more than $100,000 ($200,000 joint)
6. New deduction for up to $25,000 in tip income that starts phasing out when taxpayers earn more than $150,000 ($300,000 joint)
7. New deduction for up to $12,500 in overtime income ($25,000 for joint filers) that starts phasing out when taxpayers earn more than $150,000 ($300,000 joint)

**Tax Foundation estimates that, altogether, these seven provisions cut individual income taxes by $129 billion in 2025. **

However, the OBBBA added significantly to the federal deficit, which was already on an unsustainable path. The insolvency of major entitlements like Social Security and Medicare is just a few years away.

If you are wondering what this means for taxpayers in 2026, don't worry, you're not alone.

**Tax Foundation is dedicated to helping taxpayers understand exactly what is happening in the world of tax policy and how it affects their daily lives.**

I'm Daniel Bunn, President and CEO of Tax Foundation. Since 1937, our principled research, insightful analysis, and engaged experts have informed taxpayers and lawmakers about smarter tax policy in the US.

But to bring you the latest research, data, educational resources, and tax modeling you need to make informed decisions, Tax Foundation needs all the support it can get.

clean_body: Peter, It may seem obvious to folks like you, but not everyone knows what's on the line next year. Most may not even know taxes are changing. The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) included seven major tax cuts that took effect for 2025: 1. Maximum child tax credit increase of $200 2. Standard deduction increase of $750 for single filers and $1,500 for joint filers 3. State and local tax (SALT) deduction cap increase to $40,000 for taxpayers earning under $500,000 4. New $6,000 additional deduction for seniors that starts phasing out when taxpayers make more than $75,000 ($150,000 joint) 5. New $10,000 auto loan interest deduction that starts phasing out when taxpayers make more than $100,000 ($200,000 joint) 6. New deduction for up to $25,000 in tip income that starts phasing out when taxpayers earn more than $150,000 ($300,000 joint) 7. New deduction for up to $12,500 in overtime income ($25,000 for joint filers) that starts phasing out when taxpayers earn more than $150,000 ($300,000 joint) Tax Foundation estimates that, altogether, these seven provisions cut individual income taxes by $129 billion in 2025. However, the OBBBA added significantly to the federal deficit, which was already on an unsustainable path. The insolvency of major entitlements like Social Security and Medicare is just a few years away. If you are wondering what this means for taxpayers in 2026, don't worry, you're not alone. Right now, Congress has a clear, bipartisan path to provide permanent protections for immigrant youth — even as DACA and its recipients face relentless legal and political attacks.
**The stakes couldn't be higher.** Immigration agents continue to snatch community members from their neighborhoods without warrants. DACA recipients with valid, active status are being detained, denied their constitutional rights, and separated from their families. Thousands have lost access to healthcare due to recent budget cuts.
During this critical moment for DACA — 13 years after the program began and facing its greatest threats yet — United We Dream refuses to let immigrant communities face this alone.
Every update we share about DACA's status, every rally for the Dream Act, every resource we provide to families — it's all possible because of supporters like you. Your continued partnership will allow us to expand our advocacy throughout 2026.

clean_body: Congress has a clear, bipartisan path to provide permanent protections for immigrant youth — even as DACA and its recipients face relentless legal and political attacks. | | | Peter, There's a real opportunity right now to protect immigrant youth. Senators Dick Durbin and Lisa Murkowski recently reintroduced the bipartisan Dream Act in Congress — legislation that would finally create a pathway to citizenship for immigrants who've spent most of their lives here, building our communities and contributing to our economy. For DACA recipients who are Americans in every way except on paper, this bill represents hope for permanent protection. And we're fighting to make sure Congress takes action to safeguard the millions of lives and families at risk. | | Right now, Congress has a clear, bipartisan path to provide permanent protections for immigrant youth — even as DACA and its recipients face relentless legal and political attacks. The stakes couldn't be higher. Immigration agents continue to snatch community members from their neighborhoods without warrants. DACA recipients with valid, active status are being detained, denied their constitutional rights, and separated from their families. Thousands have lost access to healthcare due to recent budget cuts. During this critical moment for DACA — 13 years after the program began and facing its greatest threats yet — United We Dream refuses to let immigrant communities face this alone. Every update we share about DACA's status, every rally for the Dream Act, every resource we provide to families — it's all possible because of supporters like you. **If you can't read the whole thing, I'll cut to the chase:**

**[The GOP wants to use their majority to implement ALL of Trump's most extreme policy goals. I wish I was exaggerating, but I'm not. So please, will you chip in $5 _(becomes $15!)_ before tonight's end-of-month deadline to take back the Senate?](https://go.dscc.org/go/22671?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20260131-ChuckSchumer-SchumerLongForm2026RF-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20260131-ChuckSchumer-SchumerLongForm2026RF-Pros-sl1&akid=22567%2E9716520%2EV2zgvX)**

_Here are the three most important things you need to know:_

**SENATE REPUBLICANS ARE WORKING HAND-IN-HAND WITH TRUMP TO PASS HIS PLANS INTO LAW.**

Now that they have the majority, they're doing whatever it takes to cater to Trump's desires -- even if it means cutting key programs like Medicaid and Social Security!

_It gets worse:_

**EXPERTS ARE SAYING TAKING THE SENATE BACK WILL BE TOUGH.**

If we want to stop Trump's agenda, we'll NEED to take back the Senate -- but the analysts are saying it'll be an uphill battle. Factor in the Republican megadonors willing to spend hundreds of millions to keep the Senate red, and it's clear we won't have much margin for error.

_As a result:_

**WE'LL NEED ALL HANDS ON DECK TO DEFY THE ODDS AND TAKE BACK THE MAJORITY!**

It'll be a tough fight, but I know it can be done. We can only beat the odds if grassroots Democrats like you step up. **So please:**

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260131em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260131em]
I don’t want to start 2026 figuring out why we fell short — when we know exactly what’s at stake.
Tonight at midnight, our first end-of-month fundraising deadline of the year hits. We set a goal to raise $10,000, because this moment decides whether this campaign starts the year with momentum — or with excuses. So if you believe in facts and science, please donate any amount right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260131em]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260131em]
As a scientist, I’m trained to look honestly at systems and outcomes. And here’s the truth: when leaders delay, hedge, or look away, people get hurt. That’s how we ended up with a health care system that bankrupts families, rations medication, and treats illness like a profit opportunity.
I’m running because I refuse to accept that as normal. And I’m asking for your help because I know change doesn’t happen quietly — it happens when people step up together.
This deadline isn’t arbitrary. It’s about whether we can organize early, tell the truth clearly, and fight with the strength this moment demands.
We only have a few hours left. If you’re able to give — even a small amount — please do it now. Your support tonight helps determine what kind of year 2026 will be. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?refcode=260131em]

I am asking you to read this book

**This is the last call.**
A few weeks ago, we had a crazy idea.
In a few weeks, my new book comes out. It's called "Young Man in a Hurry." It's a good book. Very personal. Not your normal political book at all. But of course, there will be a bunch of political stories you'll enjoy. I think you'd like it.
At the same time, we just spent a bunch of money on passing Prop 50, so now I need to refill the coffers at my Campaign for Democracy for the fights ahead ... and heaven knows there are many fights ahead.
So we said if you make a contribution of ANY AMOUNT, I'll send you a copy of my new book.
Tomorrow night at midnight, we're going to wrap-up this idea and start getting the books out before the end of the month. So this is the last call.
The average cost per book is $22.45 including shipping. If you can give that, great. If you can only give $5, great. If you want to cover the cost for a few folks who can only give a few bucks, great. But this is the absolute last time we're going to do this before the book is public.

| | Peter,

I am a survivor of child trafficking--and today, I work to make sure other children never face what I did. My name is Theresa Flores. **I was fifteen years old.****An honor student.
****A daughter.
****A girl who trusted the wrong "friend. "**I was trafficked for two years.Most people imagine trafficking happens far away - in dark alleys or foreign countries. **To "other people."**But my nightmare happened in the suburbs of Detroit.I lived at home.
I went to high school.
**And no one noticed.** On the worst night of my life, I was taken to a dirty motel room and auctioned off to nearly two dozen men.**I remember the smell of the room.
****The fear in my chest.

Each year, the last Monday of May is observed to honor the men and women who died while serving in the United States military. Formerly known as Decoration Day, this tradition originated after the Civil War and became a federal holiday known as Memorial Day in 1971. Some dispute when the first remembrance occurred, but one of the earliest Memorial Day commemorations on record was organized by a group of former slaves in Charlestown, South Carolina shortly after the Confederacy surrendered in 1865.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.RWbj6j87jYAHZQEQBN_jILFtLG0hOFQit-govhpBaQY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=186412984)
When Decoration Day began in 1865, it honored African American Union Soldiers that had been buried in a Confederate prison camp mass gravesite. The surviving men and women worked diligently to move the bodies of those buried in the mass grave and give each of them proper burials at new gravesites. They decorated their new resting places as a sign of remembrance and respect.
That tradition continues to this day.
On May 30, 1868, thousands gathered at Arlington National Cemetery for the first official Decoration Day ceremony. Before placing flowers or wreaths on the gravesites, then Ohio Congressman James Garfield said, "We do not know one promise these men made, one pledge they gave, one word they spoke; but we do know they summed up and perfected, by one supreme act, the highest virtues of men and citizens." He further stated, "For love of country they accepted death, and thus resolved all doubts, and made immortal their patriotism and their virtue."
Garfield would later become President of the United States, but his words of gratitude that day in Arlington would forever set the tone for honoring those that have asked the least and sacrificed the most. These brave souls understood that true patriotism is a love of country and a true consciousness of its worth. Something that is lost on many in America today.
As we remember and honor the fallen, Memorial Day provides a great opportunity to reflect on the sacrifices made by these heroes. The act of giving up one's life for the greater good is a vital component to the continuation of the American way of life. A soldier's meaning of patriotism is complex and far-reaching, but it's absolute. There's no need to question their intentions or motivations; a simple thank for serving will suffice.
Thank you to all my fellow veterans past and present. You have my utmost gratitude and respect. It has been both an honor and privilege to stand with you.
_May God bless all of you, Vincent_

### **Help us replace the mainstream media by becoming a PolitiBrawl Member:**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..YLa31nBnvrMMnWK1MrRk_2-HMI9ZgvOnYjua-dpB8gk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=186073655)
* * *
I traveled to Tallahassee last week **[to interview Governor Ron DeSantis](https://substack.com/redirect/9f0c4d2b-eb82-40e7-a3dd-6cf1cf35fef6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as he is entering his final year in the statewide office. It is an understatement that DeSantis has made his mark during his two terms. From his handling of COVID-19 to running for president to dealing with the influx of Americans moving to his state, DeSantis has often been at the center of the nation's attention.
Aside from wanting to finish his second term in office on a strong note, the biggest political question he faces is who he is going to endorse in Florida's governor's race that will take place this year. The top names in the race are Rep. Byron Donalds and Lt. Governor Jay Collins.
After I asked DeSantis when he was going to make an endorsement, DeSantis said he typically does not get involved in primaries but added he wants to see how the current roster campaigns as the race heats up in the spring.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..YLa31nBnvrMMnWK1MrRk_2-HMI9ZgvOnYjua-dpB8gk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=186073655)
"I have gotten involved in some primaries, but it's usually when there's a candidate who's speaking my language, that I'm really excited to get behind. And so if that happens, then people will know, if I make that judgement. If it's not, then, you know, it just is what it is," DeSantis said.
## [You can watch DeSantis' full answer here:](https://substack.com/redirect/9f0c4d2b-eb82-40e7-a3dd-6cf1cf35fef6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/9f0c4d2b-eb82-40e7-a3dd-6cf1cf35fef6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/9f0c4d2b-eb82-40e7-a3dd-6cf1cf35fef6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The governor's race presents a challenge for DeSantis. He made it clear that he wants whoever replaces him to continue the strong gains made under his leadership. I think the main reason why DeSantis has not endorsed anyone yet is because he does not have a good relationship with Donalds, the current frontrunner.

## **Did you know some credit cards can actually help you get out of debt faster?**
Yes, it sounds crazy. But it's true.
The secret: Find a card with a "0% intro APR" period for balance transfers.
Then, transfer your debt balance and pay it down as much as possible during the intro period. No interest means you could pay off the debt faster.
**[Check out these cards today and see what the hype is all about.](https://substack.com/redirect/ae5369d6-9ff2-43d8-9e9b-f2065aebf77e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Learn More](https://substack.com/redirect/ae5369d6-9ff2-43d8-9e9b-f2065aebf77e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
_**Piece continues**_
That's a problem considering President Trump gave his endorsement to Donalds a long time ago. While DeSantis also told me he has no regrets deciding to run for president in 2024, it is not hard to assume he does not want to cause another rift with Trump considering he could be picked for a Cabinet position once he is done in Florida. The two men have made up since the 2024 primary and DeSantis has golfed with Trump multiple times when the President is on Palm Beach during the weekends.
It is interesting that DeSantis has not given his endorsement to Collins, his handpicked choice for lieutenant governor. Collins is not as well-known compared to Donalds, but if he is able to reach the undecided voters, it could work in his favor to get the governor's endorsement. Donalds' answer to the undecided voters is to deploy his full-funded war chest this spring to reintroduce himself to Florida.
Whoever DeSantis decides to endorse or not endorse, it will be fascinating to see what he will do next once he leaves office.
"Look, there'll be a lot of different things, you know, potentially out there. I'm very content here. I have my eye on nothing in particular. I'm just doing my job" as governor, DeSantis noted to me towards the end of the interview.

Peter –
As January comes to a close, I wanted to take a moment to speak to you directly.
This first month of the election year has been incredibly meaningful to me. Traveling across Colorado, meeting supporters, and seeing the passion people have for protecting our democracy has been both humbling and energizing. None of this — not the conversations, not the organizing, not the momentum we’re building — would be possible without your support.
For me, running for Attorney General is about defending our Constitution, protecting voting rights, and standing up for the rule of law when it matters most. Knowing you’re standing with me makes that fight possible.
Tonight marks the end of the very first month of the election year. How we finish January will shape what we’re able to do next — from organizing on the ground to reaching voters and building the grassroots team we need to win statewide.
If you’re able, I’m asking for one final contribution before midnight to help us close this month in the strongest possible position. Every donation, no matter the size, helps us keep moving forward with momentum and purpose. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2601-q1-jg?refcode=260131-email]
Thank you for believing in this campaign, for believing in our democracy, and for being part of this fight with me. I’m deeply grateful for your support, and I’m ready to keep going – together.
With gratitude,
Jena Griswold

Peter, you and I can both see that this country is in a time of turmoil — and that we’re running out of time to set our nation back on course. We just can’t allow the far-right GOP another two years of control in Washington. body:
I don't believe politics has to be a cycle of petty power struggles and backroom deals.

| Peter,

When you start to dream big, you learn something pretty quickly: not everyone will cheer you on. There are always people who rush in to tell you why it can't be done, why things should stay exactly as they are, or why you're asking for too much.

That's what I see in our district right now. Mariannette Miller-Meeks knows IA-01 can do better. She knows families are working harder than ever just to get by, that rural communities are being stretched thin, and that too many household budgets are breaking. Instead of rising to meet this moment, she's clinging to the status quo.

**To me, Peter, 2026 is about choosing a different path.** It's about allowing ourselves to dream of something better, and then having the courage to work toward it.

I don't believe politics has to be a cycle of petty power struggles and backroom deals. I want to be a representative who sees their neighbors as partners in building a better tomorrow where we can dream our biggest dreams for ourselves and our children. I truly believe that's what the people of IA-01 want and deserve.

That's why my team and I set an ambitious goal of raising $25,000 for our first end-of-month deadline of the year. Reaching this goal will show that our campaign is here to win, and this district is ready to move forward.

We’re ready to do the work. Are you? Mariannette Miller-Meeks knows IA-01 can do better. She knows families are working harder than ever just to get by, that rural communities are being stretched thin, and that too many household budgets are breaking. Instead of rising to meet this moment, she's clinging to the status quo. To me, Peter, 2026 is about choosing a different path. It's about allowing ourselves to dream of something better, and then having the courage to work toward it. I don't believe politics has to be a cycle of petty power struggles and backroom deals. Peter -

**I’m running to represent Washington’s 5th Congressional District in Congress because I believe we’re at a critical crossroads.**

We desperately need more problem-solving - _and less politics._

Because right now, our freshman representative isn’t fighting for Eastern Washington. He’s gone along with the MAGA crowd in DC, pushing an extreme agenda that hurts the very people who keep this region running - health care workers, educators, farmers, small business owners, and kids who deserve a fair shot.

He voted to send billions in blank-check funding to the Department of Homeland Security without accountability, while programs regular people rely on - like Medicaid, SNAP, special education funding, and veterans’ services - are on the chopping block.

And these tariff wars? They’re making life harder for our farmers, driving up prices, and bringing more uncertainty to families and businesses across our district.

**Eastern Washington deserves better than that.**

I’m running because I believe we need common-sense, accountable representation - someone who’s focused on people here at home, not wealthy special interests or political extremists back in DC.

**Outside money is already pouring into this race for the incumbent, who has already spent over half a million dollars to keep his seat. Local donors and volunteers are stepping up to support Team Eastern Washington and send Carmela Conroy to Congress. No other challenger is as prepared to fight NOW: and we need people from every corner of Eastern Washington to step up and get involved.**

Peter - MAGA doesn’t scare me.

Right-wing trolls like Megyn Kelly, Laura Loomer, and Marjorie Taylor Greene can attack me all they want - but I’m not backing down.

**Because I know exactly who I work for, and why we fight.**

I fight for the public transit and affordable housing we’re building so working families, young people, and long-time residents can actually afford to live in San Francisco.

I fight to expose the secret police Donald Trump is using to intimidate immigrant communities, so no one has to fear being taken from the streets.

I fight to cap insulin costs and take on corporate healthcare, so people can afford the medicine they need to survive.

And I fight for the _No Kings Act_ , which just passed the Senate this week, so our communities can hold federal agents accountable for their lawless behavior.

**This work matters, and if we’re going to take it to Congress, I need your help.**

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | First Invеstmеnt Updаtеs brоught tо уоu bу Іnception Media, LLC. **That has completely changed.**
I was recently on the Bulwark laying out why there’s a real reason for optimism, and why flipping the Senate is genuinely within reach.

| Hi Peter, it’s April. Yesterday, I visited the ICE detention facility in Baltimore and what I saw was shocking. This visit did not happen overnight. For months, my office has been demanding access to this facility after receiving alarming reports from attorneys, advocates, and families about conditions inside. I formally requested this visit as part of my constitutional duty to conduct oversight, but ICE granted entry only after repeated pressure and rescheduling.

You may have seen the video circulating online showing people packed into holding rooms, wrapped in foil blankets, with little access to food, water, medical care, or legal counsel. ICE officially refused to confirm whether that video was the Baltimore detention facility but when I pressed them for answers, the agents we met with confirmed it was.

This facility is supposed to be a short-term holding site, with a rule limiting detention to 12 hours. That rule has been waived and people are now routinely kept far longer than intended, in conditions that are not designed for extended detention.

There is no medical screening process. Families are asked to bring medications, but many are afraid to do so out of fear that they will also be detained.

In holding rooms that can contain up to 70 people, there is a single toilet and one shared phone. Detainees sleep on thin foam mats with no pillows and Mylar blankets. We did not see showers. People inside the cells were signaling to us that they were hungry and needed food.

These conditions are not acceptable.**I will never stop searching for the truth and fighting for transparency and accountability,_no matter what._** [_**If you believe this oversight work matters, add your name to demand transparency, humane treatment, and real accountability from ICE.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124468341/598705455/1560313598?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDkxNzIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTgzZjc4OTUtZjhmZS1mMDExLTgzMmYtMDAwZDNhMWYwZTRjIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=aUSoylvHgExKq-QZCMKjf7hVDAtxA7ESK98n8iqVcsA=&emci=627ebae5-2efe-f011-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&emdi=a83f7895-f8fe-f011-832f-000d3a1f0e4c&ceid=16017524)
