| | | Hi Peter, I wanted to make sure you saw this story, because it’s a big escalation with far-reaching consequences. If you don’t work in elections right now, you might not understand its severity, but let me tell you—this is serious. This week in Fulton County, Georgia, [the FBI seized hundreds of thousands of election records](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwobSM-TKMwDjYUaiVKYAwVbiJn3jMIZfAzWVjcMJm2q9G0tiQeCrsWmijefq4ZKYSvOnU7HK90vVWRZjWDMtoeZryZgbHcHIVZ0H1qcxREyAonSUiv4SZS0yuv4Tdh-JhxtsdE6QV55bsIi8XXe75kJJbCbZVo9owDj3r5wCd6j223_7UTNWjjt_6dTfUFToiUjMW10XicWshdMlRvMXIFc96roy6z6I6ish_JmfBjNKx4xZG0kBXye1ji6OtwFUmYc8Od8-ENxHLIPeKH_rFcn7BHg4jowGKbShhL3dAQNRZoGaU3-cPdICRtL8lumB9lwjsoT0kd-pdAe3v5dctYR7rpBlkUZJo7E8y53m4H4icZcxtC_d89AeYT5tLEvX8mZ3a8inD6sHOz_4Ny7W0RZGMAXPscfm63j01SrF3TyOd/4nr/d9goJ69GTwyNDPcoE0-3Mg/h0/h001.6FokyA2f-jdWIJcKfqkzJYIMPOyD6SPry_WnBvkqPXA) from an election office. Ballots. Tabulator records. Sensitive election materials that had already been audited, certified, and confirmed. No inventory of what was taken, no chain of custody protocols.
> Nicole Craine for The New York Times
**This is what happens when The Big Lie metastasizes** —when Donald Trump’s false claims about the 2020 election are allowed to grow, mutate, and infect every institution they touch. What started as a lie and grew to become a fully unhinged crusade, has so far faced limited success in getting its hands on actual election records. Now that’s changed. To be clear, it doesn’t matter to them what the records say. They’re going to tell us they’ve reviewed them and found evidence of fraud. **They’ll manufacture an “A-ha!” moment and use that as justification to interfere in the 2026 and 2028 elections.** That’s the real goal. So now you have to ask yourself, who do you want at the helm when the FBI or ICE or the DOJ are on their way to Colorado with their big trucks and small...hands? **Colorado needs a Secretary of State who’s an expert in election law.** Who knows the rules for chain of custody and election record handling and can enforce those rules with legal authority. Someone who is ready to defend Colorado voters and Colorado elections with the ferocity these fights will require. I know exactly how serious this moment is, and I’m the only candidate prepared to meet it. I’m not an alarmist. In fact, the people who know me best would probably say I’m unusually calm under pressure. But this is real, and it’s only going to get more real the deeper into this year we go. I need your support; our democracy needs your support. **I’m just $1,500 away from meeting our fundraising goal for this month–can you help me get there? If you can contribute today, I’d really appreciate it.** [>> Donate Now](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqum6oshDjP8NRpbzhRH5VoGDyXE__t_oVPlLw1RwMtghBfVqBPMNCvoA8yb6ESDTAZtS70swxoHp-KeYvbjr5fWInG23F4upPCxxjYpIt5ykh86rz0-wjZFwMQ0l1RFkxazw4kupLkBnd9_Vxv9mqDZP-BOQvDWMYXvFBLukkv72G_6NHw4L8bIhqNuSOdUm6MLIzEfgNmKRG3vcHXl6AbdEDc9H8syxeBUDbvItMjXCcVHlKFEwETMvAhnl-oWdV3-8ktxGeByGQZkVL7aE5gg1AlVfM81cp4tiUSua4G14oPCh8kYvYHLf8wW1DbuP3G_bMO_lzp_LtGpWV-BgC5wDawjweIir5Orh5IGWhamrQ/4nr/d9goJ69GTwyNDPcoE0-3Mg/h1/h001.dgYg2PcyHzrOuUUGyE-lnkBORjcGShRXIORHGj34OfM) It’s not just Georgia. We’ve heard reports of similar, smaller scale activities in other counties and other states. It’s coming here, in some form or another. But I’m ready. And Colorado will be, too. In solidarity, Amanda Gonzalez

clean_body: | | | Hi Peter, I wanted to make sure you saw this story, because it’s a big escalation with far-reaching consequences. If you don’t work in elections right now, you might not understand its severity, but let me tell you—this is serious. This week in Fulton County, Georgia, from an election office. Ballots. Tabulator records. Sensitive election materials that had already been audited, certified, and confirmed. No inventory of what was taken, no chain of custody protocols. Nicole Craine for The New York Times This is what happens when The Big Lie metastasizes —when Donald Trump’s false claims about the 2020 election are allowed to grow, mutate, and infect every institution they touch. What started as a lie and grew to become a fully unhinged crusade, has so far faced limited success in getting its hands on actual election records. Now that’s changed. To be clear, it doesn’t matter to them what the records say. They’re going to tell us they’ve reviewed them and found evidence of fraud. They’ll manufacture an “A-ha!” moment and use that as justification to interfere in the 2026 and 2028 elections. That’s the real goal. So now you have to ask yourself, who do you want at the helm when the FBI or ICE or the DOJ are on their way to Colorado with their big trucks and small...hands? Colorado needs a Secretary of State who’s an expert in election law. Who knows the rules for chain of custody and election record handling and can enforce those rules with legal authority. Someone who is ready to defend Colorado voters and Colorado elections with the ferocity these fights will require. I know exactly how serious this moment is, and I’m the only candidate prepared to meet it. I’m not an alarmist. In fact, the people who know me best would probably say I’m unusually calm under pressure. But this is real, and it’s only going to get more real the deeper into this year we go. I need your support; our democracy needs your support. I’m just $1,500 away from meeting our fundraising goal for this month–can you help me get there? If you can contribute today, I’d really appreciate it. It’s not just Georgia. We’ve heard reports of similar, smaller scale activities in other counties and other states. It’s coming here, in some form or another. But I’m ready. And Colorado will be, too. In solidarity, Amanda Gonzalez Candidate for Colorado Secretary of State p.s. If you want to do more for this campaign, I’d love your support at caucus and assembly! That’s how I’ll get on the ballot so you can vote for me in June and November. name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Midnight
body:
If you’re with me, I need your support right now.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
I know you’ve heard a lot from me since we launched this campaign last year, and there’s a good reason for that. We’re up against Greg Abbott’s $100+ million warchest and the corrupt corporations backers who are bankrolling his campaign.
I know that grassroots support is stronger than the billionaires and special interests. I’ve seen it in action many times. But like I’ve said before: **A leap of faith only works if you take it.** And we all have to take this leap of faith together.
Unlike Greg Abbott, I won’t be a governor who owes favors to billionaires and megacorporations. I’m funded by the people of Texas because I’m in this fight for the people of Texas — and I’m honored to have so many of you with me.
I’ll be honest, I don’t enjoy asking for money. But I am fully committed to this kind of campaigning because grassroots fundraising is the way we keep up — and win.
Republican leaders have been failing our state for decades. But I know we can turn things around with leadership that focuses on making Texans’ lives better, not dragging us into endless culture wars and serving the elite class at our expense.
If you’re with me, I need you to show your support one last time before midnight. We can reach our end-of-month fundraising goal. In fact, we’re so close that I believe we can get there in the next hour if we dig deep and do it together.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
New Jersey needs our support.
#
Now more than ever, we need progressive fighters in Washington. That’s why **I’m proud to stand behind Analilia Mejia’s campaign for Congress**.
Analilia has been on the frontlines of some of our most critical battles — from immigrant rights and universal healthcare, to higher wages and real accountability for the powerful — and she will be a force for working people in Congress.
But lobbyists, corporations, and the ultra-rich are threatened by Analilia’s promise to tax billionaires and reform the courts.
They know that **every seat that a progressive wins in the House of Representatives helps us to hold the oligarchy — and Trump — accountable**. The election is in just five days, and Analilia needs us to have her back.
[Will you split a $5 contribution between our two campaigns — $2.50 for each team — so that we can bring a progressive champion to the House and keep up the fight for working families in New Jersey and across the country?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260131-2.HGEQVH&refcode=em20260131-10662-P_FND_SPL_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10662%2E2526796%2EVUCsMU)

Analilia was a union organizer, led the New Jersey Working Families Party, served as National Political Director for Bernie Sanders' 2020 presidential campaign, and was Deputy Director of the Women's Bureau at the Department of Labor under President Biden.
Today, she serves as Co-Executive Director of Popular Democracy, helping communities across the country push back against Trump and fight to restore the promise of a just democracy.
Analilia is ready to be a force against MAGA in Congress. Let’s stand with her.
[We can’t wait for change to happen — we must elect brawlers for the working class who will speak for us, not lobbyists. Help strengthen our progressive movement in Congress by splitting a $5 contribution between us today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260131-2.HGEQVH&refcode=em20260131-10662-P_FND_SPL_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=10662%2E2526796%2EVUCsMU)

Whether or not you can contribute today, thank you for standing with us in this fight for a better world.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

body:
If we don’t get off our butts and help Chris Pappas right now, we can kiss the Senate majority goodbye.
#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/100274?refcode=em20260131-10014&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10014%2E614464%2E4uZhLZ)
Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve been around the block a few times and worked on a heck of a lot of campaigns. So believe me when I tell you: **This ain’t good.**
John Sununu — yeah, _those Sununus_ — just jumped into the U.S. Senate race in New Hampshire. And now the political eggheads have DOWNGRADED Democrats’ chances of winning there.

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: The “easy” way to bankroll your campaign
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1001&akid=1639%2E251025%2E6D52rw ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1002&akid=1639%2E251025%2E6D52rw ]Abdul for US Senate

Peter, there’s one thing about politics that really bothers me.

It’s the fact that in most cases, the candidate who raises the most money
usually wins.

Alongside that, campaigns have become incredibly expensive to run. We need
money to get our message across in-person, online, and on TV.

Those two reasons are why many candidates, including my opponents, have
taken money from corporate PACs and AIPAC. It’s the “easy” way to bankroll
your campaign quickly.

But it’s not “easy” in my eyes. It’s selling off your voting power
(assuming you win) to the highest bidder.

I refuse to be a part of that broken system. That’s why I have never and
will never take money from corporate PACs or AIPAC.

I won’t pretend that choice is convenient. It makes funding this campaign
a lot harder. The price of authenticity isn’t cheap,
Peter.

That’s why, even though I don’t like doing it, I have to ask for your
support.

Donations of $25, $10, or even $5 from regular folks like you allow our
campaign to schedule more events, pay our staff, and get ads up on the
air.

I know not everyone is in a position to give right now, and that’s okay.
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260131-2-ak.9w6qwq&amount=10&refcode=em20260131-1631&t=1004&akid=1639%2E251025%2E6D52rw ]But if you’re able to, could you chip in a few bucks to fuel this
movement? Any amount helps.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260131-2-ak.9w6qwq&amount=10&refcode=em20260131-1631&t=1023&akid=1639%2E251025%2E6D52rw ]Donate $10 ››

It’s no exaggeration to say all of this wouldn’t be possible without
people like you pitching in. So truly, thank you for your support.

Your friend in the fight,

Abdul
